# LibreOffice Calc GUI Interface Description

## Window and Application Header
- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "SafetyEvaluation.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc"
- **System Information Bar**: Shows "Oct 22 22:36" with a notification bell icon
- **Window Control Buttons**: Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons on the top-right corner
- **Desktop Environment Indicator**: "Activities" label on the top-left corner

## Application Menu Bar
- **Menu Items**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help
- **Active Menu**: "Format" menu is currently open and highlighted

## Format Menu Dropdown
- **Text Submenu**: Contains "Text", "Align Text", "Number Format", "Clone Formatting", "Clear Direct Formatting (Ctrl+M)"
- **Cell Operations Submenu**: Contains "Cells...", "Rows", "Columns", "Merge and Unmerge Cells"
- **Formatting Submenu**: Contains "Character...", "Paragraph...", "Page Style...", "Print Ranges"
- **Conditional Formatting**: "Conditional", "AutoFormat Styles...", "Spreadsheet Theme"
- **Object Management**: "Image", "Chart", "Object", "Name...", "Description..."
- **Layout and Positioning**: "Anchor", "Arrange", "Flip", "Group"

## Toolbar
- **Quick Access Toolbar**: Contains icons for common actions
- **Font Selection**: "Calibri" font is selected with a dropdown menu
- **Formatting Icons**: Includes text alignment, font style, number formatting, and other formatting tools
- **Special Characters**: Omega (Ω) symbol with dropdown
- **Insertion Tools**: Includes image, chart, and object insertion icons
- **Cell Operations**: Includes merge, split, and formatting icons
- **Drawing Tools**: Includes pen and shape tools

## Spreadsheet Grid
- **Column Headers**: Columns labeled from A to R
- **Row Headers**: Rows numbered from 1 to 29
- **Selected Area**: Row 1, columns A to C are selected (highlighted in blue)
- **Cell Content**:
  - Cell A1: "Safety Evaluation"
  - Cell A2: "Setting"
  - Cell A3: "User misuse"
  - Cell A4: "Third-party misuse"
  - Cell A5: "Misalignment"
  - Cell A6: "Thunderbird"
  - Cell A7: "VS Code"
  - Cell A8: "Multi apps"
  - Cell A9: "Chrome"
  - Cell C1: "Agent v2"
  - Cell C2: "Score"
  - Cell C3: "93%"
  - Cell C4: "55%"
  - Cell C5: "20%"
  - Cell C6: "73%"
  - Cell C7: "47%"
  - Cell C8: "64%"
  - Cell C9: "41%"
  - Cell D2: "score indicates a less safe model"
  - Cell D3: "results are quite concerning"

## Sidebar and Status Bar
- **Sidebar Icons**: Includes application shortcuts and tools
- **Status Bar**: Displays "Sheet 1 of 1", "Selected: 1 row, 3 columns", "PageStyle_Safety Eval", "English (Hong Kong)", "Average: ; Sum: 0", and zoom level "100%"
- **Additional Elements**: "Get involved" and "Donate" buttons in the top-right corner of the spreadsheet area

## Desktop Environment
- **Left Dock**: Contains application icons including Chrome, Thunderbird, Visual Studio Code, VLC, LibreOffice, and others
- **Bottom Dock**: Contains system tray icons and a grid icon for application launcher

## Additional UI Elements
- **Notification Area**: Bell icon in the top-right corner
- **Language Setting**: "English (Hong Kong)" displayed in the status bar
- **Zoom Control**: Slider and percentage indicator for zoom level

## Visual Design
- **Color Scheme**: Light gray background with white cells, blue selection highlight
- **Font**: Calibri font used throughout
- **Icons**: Standard application icons with clear visual representation
- **Layout**: Clean, organized layout with clear separation between menus, toolbar, spreadsheet, and sidebar

## Functional Elements
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Visible for "Clone Formatting" (Ctrl+M) and "Clear Direct Formatting" (Ctrl+M)
- **Interactive Elements**: Dropdown menus, buttons, and icons that respond to user input
- **Selection Highlight**: Blue highlight indicates selected cells (A1:C1)
- **Text Formatting**: Bold text for headings, normal text for data entries

## Contextual Information
- **Document Name**: "SafetyEvaluation.xlsx"
- **Sheet Name**: "Safety Eval"
- **Content Theme**: Safety evaluation of different applications or models
- **Data Type**:
